rules.title: Landlord Application Fee Prohibition
rules.requirement: Lessors are prohibited from charging prospective tenants application fees or any payments prior to the beginning of a tenancy other than first month's rent, last month's rent, security deposit, and lock-change fee.

coverage.summary: Applies to lessors renting residential property.

rules.exemptions: Licensed brokers may charge fees under specific conditions.
rules.quoted_span: It states that prior to the beginning of a tenancy, no lessor may require payment for anything except first, last, security, and locks ( MGL Ch 186 Section 15B ).
